title: StatePlane: A Cognitive State Plane for Long-Horizon AI Systems Under Bounded Context
authors: Sasank Annapureddy; John Mulcahy; Anjaneya Prasad Thamatani
why_relevant: Proposes a cognitive state plane for long-horizon agents with some mention of prompt injection defense and write-path anti-poisoning, tangentially related to RAG robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on memory/state management for agents under bounded context, not on robust RAG under unreliable evidence; robustness claims are peripheral and unvalidated.
